newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: JG Summit's Eurobond a success - lead ING.
newsitem.headline: JG Summit's Eurobond a success - lead ING.

text.p: The $200 million Eurobond flotation of Philippine conglomerate JG Summit Holdings Inc is a success, lead arranger ING Barings said on Wednesday.

"The flotation (is) a big success following a high level of investor reception in an international roadshow that saw senior JG Summit officials hold special investor presentations and meetings in Singapore, Seoul, Taipei, London, New York, Boston, San Francisco and Los Angeles," ING said in a statement.
The company is using the proceeds to finance investments in its petrochemical, telecommunications and cement subsidiaries.
The bond is priced at a spread of 180 basis points over the U.S. Treasury.
The $200 million Eurobond is the first part of a $500 million Global Medium Term Note programme of the company.
